The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b1b750b309e5c5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 59-60. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let g : W → Y and h : W → Z be surjective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth projective complex varieties. Let B be an effective rational SNC boundary, and let DY be a reduced SNC divisor, with the zero divisor allowed. Assume B ≥ (g∗ DY )red, κ(Y, KY + DY ) ≥ 0. 60 OPENAI Let A be a nef rational divisor on Z such that KZ + aA is big for all sufficiently large rational a. Put M = h∗ A, L(c) = KW + B + cM, d = dim(W/Y ), and suppose L(1) is big over Y . On smooth birational models, with the boundary rule of Lemma 2.2, there are morphisms W q − → U j − → Z, U s − → T0, S p − → T0, ρ : S → Y with the following properties: (1) h = jq, and q is the relative Iitaka fibration of KW + B over Z. Its geometric general fiber G is integral and satisfies κ(G, KG + BG) = 0. (2) The map g factors through S; ρ is birational, and W → (S ×T0 U)main is dominant and generically finite. The generic fibers of S → T0 and U → T0 are geometrically integral. With DS = (ρ∗DY )red made SNC, one has κ(St, KSt + DS|St ) = 0 for very general t. (3) One has (8.1) κ(W, L(1)) = dim U = d + dim T0, κ(Y, KY + DY ) ≤ dim T0. Rational linear equivalence in the definition of M is sufficient. All section comparisons are with the fixed initial source model.
